# Positive nominal-record fixtures

This directory contains source programs that Slice 4.1 must accept: nominal
record schemas, contextual values, forward type collection, nested records, and
field-order normalization.

Within the ecosystem these immutable inputs connect portable record contracts
to compiler lowering, public logical IR, reader traversal, probe summaries, and
Stage 4 conformance evidence.
